observations: Photo 0 shows an iPhone screen with Japanese text indicating it is locked to its owner via iCloud. The lock screen displays a padlock icon and the message 'iPhoneは所有者にロックされています' (This iPhone is locked to its owner).
The screen also shows a partially visible iCloud email address ending in '@icloud.com'.

Photo 1 shows the back of the iPhone with the glass panel removed, exposing the internal components. The camera module is visible with three lenses and a flash. The back panel is broken and partially peeled off, with visible damage and adhesive residue.
A green sticker with 'BASIT' written on it is attached to the lower part of the back panel.
The phone appears to be an iPhone with a triple-camera setup, likely an iPhone 11 Pro or later model, based on the camera layout and design.
The screen in photo 0 is functional and displaying content, but the phone is iCloud-locked, which prevents use without the owner's credentials.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the iCloud lock screen with Japanese text and a padlock icon.
Photo 0 shows the screen is functional, but there is no visual evidence of a replacement screen. No signs of repair or new screen components are visible.
Photo 1 shows the back glass panel is removed and damaged, with visible cracks and peeling adhesive.

risks.risk: iCloud lock prevents activation and use without the original owner's credentials
risks.proof: A screenshot of the phone successfully activated and logged into a new account, or a video showing the lock being bypassed.
risks.if_unproven: priced as non-functional for a buyer without iCloud credentials

risks.risk: Internal damage from broken back panel may affect battery, camera, or other components
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the internal components, especially the battery and motherboard, with no visible damage or corrosion.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or with reduced value due to possible internal damage

risks.risk: Screen replacement may be of low quality or improperly installed, affecting display or touch functionality
risks.proof: A video showing the screen being touched and responding correctly, with no dead pixels or color distortion.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially non-functional or with reduced value due to possible screen issues

proof_requests: Video showing the phone being turned on and displaying the lock screen, then attempting to activate it (to confirm iCloud lock status).
Photo or video of the internal components, especially the battery and motherboard, to check for damage.
Video showing the screen being touched and responding correctly, with no dead pixels or color distortion.
response.reason: The phone is clearly iCloud-locked and has a broken back panel, but the screen replacement and internal condition are unverified. Without proof of screen functionality and internal damage, the item cannot be priced accurately. The iCloud lock alone makes it non-functional for most buyers, so proof of activation or bypass is essential.
